what_is_nrt.name: What is Nether Republic Transport
data: The backbone of transportation in the Nether Republic.
National operator of train, metro and tram tracks.
National carrier of trains, metro and trams.
Only NRT-operated vehicles are considered official.

history.description: Rebuilt the entire website from scratch using custom HTML and CSS and published to Netlify, replacing Google Sites
Changed URL from srt0.netlify.app to sigma-republic-transport.netlify.app
